model.delayed: d*(W+f*(a-c)*C), with d=0.5 and lost fraction f
model.break_even: f*=(1/d-1)*W/((a-c)*C); same expression for binary full-miss probability under risk-neutral expected cost
model.limitations: No latency or quality utility, no actual delay intervention or physical expiry; fixed quota reference has no time benefit.
